description: Fetch the structured asset snapshot JSON for a scenario — the same content rendered in the PDF/Excel exports, in machine-readable form. Includes verdict, drivers, assumptions, evidence summary, and (if available) signed-export hashes pointing to the latest signed artifacts.

scenario_id.description: UUID of the scenario to fetch the asset snapshot payload for.

name: get_dossier

outputSchema.description: Canonical PhaseFolio envelope. Substantive payload is in `data`.

data.description: Structured asset snapshot payload mirroring the PDF/Excel exports. Top-level keys include verdict, drivers, assumptions, evidence, and (when available) signed_export hashes. See get_methodology('evidence-standards') for the full structure.
